name: Busa Shop
description: Public storefront website for a small cross-border seller. The website shows the products of the Busa Product Hub template (it keeps no copy of its own), takes order requests into Orders, reads what it shows from Settings, and the daily shop check writes its findings into Reports. Install Busa Product Hub first.

label.en: Import a product list into the product hub
label.zh-CN: 把商品放进店（导入商品表）

agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow "Import the product list" in "Open the shop": run busa-product-hub's `scripts/import-products.mjs` on the Excel or CSV file (and photos) I give you, with `--dry-run` first, show me the preview, then run it for real once I say yes. If I also ask you to take old products down, list them in the same preview and archive them after my yes, as step 2 says. Never invent a value the list does not contain.

agentPrompts.label: Open my shop
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow "Open the shop": check the product list it will sell from, the settings, and the members-only preview, and tell me exactly what I still have to do before I click Go live.

agentPrompts.label: Run today's shop check
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow its "Daily shop check": apply my feedback on the previous report first, then check products, certificates, orders and the live site, and write one new report.

agentPrompts.label: Handle new orders
agentPrompts.body: Read the `busa-shop` skill in this folder and follow "Handle a new order" for every order that is still new. Draft the replies for me; do not email anyone and do not mark anything paid or shipped.
